description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, styling, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by rendering the App component into the DOM element with the id 'root', wrapped in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree within the root.
